name: Vector Field
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Which way a quantity increases across the tissue, as arrows over the section. Gene, cell type or any annotation column — with every arrow that could be noise removed.

params.name: source
params.label: Gradient of
params.help:
Selects the quantity whose gradient is drawn.
For a cell type or any other category, that is its local fraction of cells; for a gene, its local mean expression; for a continuous column, its local mean value.

params.name: field
params.label: Column
params.help:
Selects the categorical column the category comes from.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: level
params.label: Category
params.help:
Selects the category whose local fraction of cells is mapped.
Cells with no label in this column are left out of the field.

params.name: gene
params.label: Gene
params.help:
Selects the gene whose expression is mapped.
Values are normalized to a total of 10,000 counts per cell.

params.name: column
params.label: Column
params.help: Selects the per-cell measurement whose local mean is mapped.

params.name: sigma
params.label: Smoothing
params.help:
Sets the width σ of the Gaussian smoothing, in grid cells.
Larger values produce smoother fields with broader, weaker gradients.

params.name: detail
params.label: Grid detail
params.help:
Sets the spatial resolution of the calculation.
Higher values capture finer but noisier spatial changes.

params.name: arrows
params.label: Arrows
params.help:
Sets the approximate number of arrows displayed.
This changes the display density, not the calculated field.

params.name: gate
params.label: Hide arrows that are not significant
params.help:
Shows only positions with z ≥ 3 and at least 30 effective cells.
Turning it off also displays gradients that may reflect noise.
